title: Applying the totalized action
statement: For every finite binary Turing machine $M$, every input word $x$, and every configuration $c$ of $M$ on $x$, applying the totalized source action at $c$ to $c$ gives the configuration obtained by one machine step from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite binary Turing machine
c is a configuration of M on x
replaced:
For every binary machine $M$ and every configuration $c$ of $M$, applying the
totalized action of $M$ at $c$ to $c$ yields exactly one machine step of $M$ from $c$,
including the idle step performed after $M$ has halted.
